It’s set in the Android native activity: [android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/secure_ebook_reader/MainActivity.kt:8](/home/joe/Videos/Code/new/loho-ebook-reader/android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/secure_ebook_reader/MainActivity.kt#L8).

The blocking code is:

```kotlin
override fun onPostResume() {
    super.onPostResume()
    window?.setFlags(
        WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE,
        WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE
    )
}
```

`FLAG_SECURE` is what tells Android to block screenshots and screen recording. There’s also a note about it in [BUNDLED_EBOOKS_SETUP.md:37](/home/joe/Videos/Code/new/loho-ebook-reader/BUNDLED_EBOOKS_SETUP.md#L37).

I didn’t find an equivalent iOS screenshot-prevention hook in this repo, so this setting currently looks Android-only.
